ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
A person stands on a platform in a well and uses a fixed pulley system as shown in the figure to pull the rope and lift the platform and themselves up. The two segments of the rope passing over the pulley are considered vertical, and friction is negligible. The mass of the platform is $m{=}15\mathrm{kg}$, the mass of the person is $M=55\mathrm{kg}$, and the upward acceleration of the platform at startup is $a=0.2\mathrm{m}/\mathrm{s}^{2}$.

1. What is the pressure exerted by the person on the platform at this moment?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, above there is a fixed pulley fixed at the wellhead or ceiling; a rope passes around the pulley, the left vertical rope segment goes downward and is connected to the platform, and the right vertical rope segment goes downward and is held by the person standing on the platform. The person stands inside the platform, and the platform and the person move upward together. The two rope segments passing around the pulley can be regarded as vertical, and pulley friction is ignored, so the tension in the rope is the same, denoted as T. Reasoning: According to the specified method, first regard the “person + platform” as a whole. Among the external forces acting on this whole, upward there are two rope tensions: one acts on the rope end of the platform, and one acts on the person's hand, so the total upward pulling force is 2T; the downward gravity is (M+m)g. The whole has upward acceleration a, therefore 2T - (M+m)g = (M+m)a. Substituting M=55 kg, m=15 kg, a=0.2 m/s^2, and taking g=10 m/s^2: 2T - 70×10 = 70×0.2, 2T - 700 = 14, 2T = 714, T = 357 N. Then analyze the person separately. The person is subject to the upward support force N of the platform and rope tension T, and is subject to gravity Mg downward, and moves upward with the platform with acceleration a, therefore N + T - Mg = Ma. Substituting the values: N + 357 - 55×10 = 55×0.2, N + 357 - 550 = 11, N = 204 N. This is the support force of the platform on the person. According to Newton's third law, the pressure exerted by the person on the platform is equal in magnitude and opposite in direction, so the pressure exerted by the person on the platform is 204 N, in the vertically downward direction.

The two segments of the rope passing over the pulley are considered vertical, and friction is negligible. The mass of the platform is $m=15\mathrm{kg}$, the mass of the person is $M=55\mathrm{kg}$, and the upward acceleration of the platform at startup is $a=0.2\mathrm{m}/\mathrm{s}^{2}$. method.method_draft: First read the diagram as a fixed ceiling pulley with one rope end attached to the platform and the other vertical rope segment held by the person standing on the platform. Treat the person plus platform as one system: the only external upward rope forces on that combined system are two equal tensions, one at the platform attachment and one on the person's hand. Use the text values m=15 kg, M=55 kg, upward acceleration a=0.2 m/s^2, negligible friction, and same tension in the rope. Apply Newton's second law to the combined system to get 2T-(M+m)g=(M+m)a. Then isolate the person: upward forces are the platform normal N and rope tension T, downward force is Mg, with upward acceleration a, so N+T-Mg=Ma. Solve for N, then report the person's force on the platform as equal in magnitude and opposite in direction: about 204 N downward using g=10 m/s^2.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中上方有一个固定在井口或天花板处的定滑轮；一根绳子绕过滑轮，左侧竖直绳段向下并连接到平台，右侧竖直绳段向下由站在平台上的人拉住。人站在平台内部，平台和人一起向上运动。两段绕过滑轮的绳子可视为竖直，滑轮摩擦忽略，因此绳中张力相同，记为 T。

推理：按指定方法，先把“人+平台”看作一个整体。这个整体受到的外力中，向上有两处绳子张力：一处作用在平台的绳端，一处作用在人手上，所以总向上拉力为 2T；向下重力为 (M+m)g。整体向上加速度为 a，因此
2T - (M+m)g = (M+m)a。
代入 M=55 kg，m=15 kg，a=0.2 m/s^2，取 g=10 m/s^2：
2T - 70×10 = 70×0.2，
2T - 700 = 14，
2T = 714，
T = 357 N。

再单独分析人。人受到向上的平台支持力 N 和绳子张力 T，向下受到重力 Mg，并随平台以加速度 a 向上运动，因此
N + T - Mg = Ma。
代入数值：
N + 357 - 55×10 = 55×0.2，
N + 357 - 550 = 11，
N = 204 N。
这是平台对人的支持力。根据牛顿第三定律，人对平台的压力大小相等、方向相反，所以人为平台施加的压力为 204 N，方向竖直向下。

method.method_draft: First read the diagram as two interacting bodies: the platform is pulled upward by the left vertical rope segment, while the person stands on it and pulls the right vertical segment, so the rope also pulls upward on the person. Draw separate free-body equations for platform and person without first considering the combined system. For the platform, forces are upward rope tension T, downward platform weight mg, and downward contact force N from the person: T-mg-N=ma. For the person, forces are upward platform normal N and upward rope tension T, downward weight Mg: N+T-Mg=Ma. Use the text data m=15 kg, M=55 kg, a=0.2 m/s^2 and same tension due to negligible friction. Eliminate T between the two equations to get 2N=(M-m)(g+a), so N=204 N for g=10 m/s^2. The asked pressure exerted by the person on the platform is this normal-contact force directed vertically downward.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中顶部有一个固定在井口/天花板上的定滑轮，一根绳子绕过滑轮。绳子的左侧竖直段向下连接到平台，右侧竖直段向下由站在平台上的人拉住；人站在平台内。题目说明两段绳子可看作竖直，且摩擦忽略，因此绳中张力相同，记为 T。推理：把平台和人分开受力分析。对平台，向上受左侧绳子的张力 T，向下受平台重力 mg 和人对平台的压力 N，平台向上加速度为 a，所以 T - mg - N = ma。对人，向上受平台支持力 N 和绳子张力 T，向下受重力 Mg，人也随平台向上加速度 a，所以 N + T - Mg = Ma。由平台方程得 T = m(g+a) + N；由人方程得 T = M(g+a) - N。两式相等：m(g+a)+N = M(g+a)-N，因此 2N = (M-m)(g+a)。代入 m=15 kg，M=55 kg，a=0.2 m/s^2，取 g=10 m/s^2，得 N = (55-15)(10+0.2)/2 = 204 N。这个 N 是平台对人的支持力大小；人对平台的压力与其大小相等、方向相反，故方向竖直向下。

The two segments of the rope passing over the pulley are considered vertical, and friction is negligible. The two segments of the rope passing over the pulley are considered vertical, and friction is negligible. The mass of the platform is $m=15\mathrm{kg}$, the mass of the person is $M=55\mathrm{kg}$, and the upward acceleration of the platform at startup is $a=0.2\mathrm{m}/\mathrm{s}^{2}$. ready3_open_rewrite.final_cot:
Image description: In the figure, above there is a fixed pulley fixed at the wellhead or ceiling; a rope passes around the pulley, the left vertical rope segment goes downward and is connected to the platform, and the right vertical rope segment goes downward and is held by the person standing on the platform. The person stands inside the platform, and the platform and the person move upward together. The two rope segments passing around the pulley can be regarded as vertical, and pulley friction is ignored, so the tension in the rope is the same, denoted as T.

Reasoning: According to the specified method, first regard the “person + platform” as a whole. Among the external forces acting on this whole, upward there are two rope tensions: one acts on the rope end of the platform, and one acts on the person's hand, so the total upward pulling force is 2T; the downward gravity is (M+m)g. The whole has upward acceleration a, therefore
2T - (M+m)g = (M+m)a.
Substituting M=55 kg, m=15 kg, a=0.2 m/s^2, and taking g=10 m/s^2:
2T - 70×10 = 70×0.2,
2T - 700 = 14,
2T = 714,
T = 357 N.

Then analyze the person separately. The person is subject to the upward support force N of the platform and rope tension T, and is subject to gravity Mg downward, and moves upward with the platform with acceleration a, therefore
N + T - Mg = Ma.
Substituting the values:
N + 357 - 55×10 = 55×0.2,
N + 357 - 550 = 11,
N = 204 N.
This is the support force of the platform on the person. According to Newton's third law, the pressure exerted by the person on the platform is equal in magnitude and opposite in direction, so the pressure exerted by the person on the platform is 204 N, in the vertically downward direction.
